assets.name: terrain
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A precise game GROUND TILE ATLAS on transparent alpha, square 1024x1024, EXACT 4 columns and 4 rows, no grid lines or words. Each cell contains ONE flat 2:1 isometric diamond tile, NO EXTRUSION, NO raised side faces. In each equal square cell the diamond's left and right vertices touch the cell's left and right midpoints; top vertex is at 25% of cell height, bottom at 75%. All pixels outside the diamond transparent. Tiles are seen orthographically and are intended to connect without seams. Detailed subtle hand-painted cozy 3D H5 coffee adventure ground, no hard dark tile outlines, no objects. Row1 four compatible warm walnut/oak parquet floor variations. Row2 four compatible rainy dark blue asphalt variations with subtle mottled wet sheen, no road markings. Row3 four compatible muted blue-gray cobblestone sidewalk variations with irregular stones and wet flecks. Row4 first two cells mossy ancient sandstone path variants, third cell lush small-leaf grass texture, fourth cell deep forest earth and low grass. Flat lighting, no directional cast shadows, no scene, no landscape background. Every diamond stays exactly inside its own cell.
assets.normalization: Opaque diamond bounds are normalized to the existing 128x64 isometric ground footprint at runtime.
